releases.notes:
Automatic backups were being left unencrypted, and were far larger than they needed to be.

The appliance takes a backup on a schedule, encrypts it, and deletes the unencrypted copy. A recent
change meant it could no longer confirm when Home Assistant had finished writing the backup — so it
treated a successful backup as a failure, and the encryption step never ran. Unencrypted copies were
left behind. That is fixed, and any that were left have been removed.

Separately, a scheduled backup was including the downloaded installer for a pending system update —
around 580 MB of a 582 MB backup, against roughly 1 MB of your actual settings and history. Update
installers are downloaded again when needed, so they are no longer included. Backups are back to
about a megabyte.

Nothing about how your home behaves changes.
